snippet.title: Lost Totem Trajipon! "Execute" Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST LOST TOTEM TRAJIPON! ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4624790/Lost_Totem_Trajipon/
Capture Minions. Sacrifice them. They will serve you. You will save Trajipon.
Lost Totem Trajipon! is comin to PC in 2026.

Returning home after a long absence, you find Trajipon in shambles. The roads are closed. The people are scared. The wildlife is monstrous... but ready to be bent to your will.

The land of Trajipon may be shrouded in darkness, but you can shed light on it. Be careful, because if you fail, you'll have to begin anew. In your darkest moments, you can even the odds with a Bullet.

Follow SolPlex Entertainment on Bluesky and Twitter:
https://bsky.app/profile/solplexdev.bsky.social
https://x.com/SolPlexDev

NOTE: Da Boss personally confirmed dat Lost Totem Trajipon! contains at least 99% LESS ghosts than when we first found it. Dat means it AINT HAUNTED.
-Guido
